title: Bank & ATM
description: Phrases for withdrawing cash, card problems and basic banking needs.

phrases.pt: Onde tem um caixa eletrônico por aqui?
phrases.en: Where is there an ATM around here?
phrases.ipa: ˈõ.dʒi tẽj ũ ˈkaj.ʃɐ e.leˈtɾõ.ni.ku poʁ aˈki

phrases.pt: O caixa não aceitou meu cartão.
phrases.en: The ATM didn’t accept my card.
phrases.ipa: u ˈkaj.ʃɐ nɐ̃w a.sejˈtow mew kaʁˈtɐ̃w

phrases.pt: Qual é a taxa de saque?
phrases.ipa: kwaw ɛ a ˈta.ksɐ dʒi ˈsa.ki

phrases.en: I need to exchange dollars for reais.
Is the exchange rate good today?
Can I speak with the manager?
